cases.name: Alexis Faith "Lexi" Boland
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Alexis graduated from Princeville High School in 2019 and was currently attending Illinois Central College. She worked as a dental assistant at Dr. Martin Ruelas office in Peoria. Alexis enjoyed shopping, shoes, and had a great sense of style for everything from nails to eyebrows and hair. Her children were her world and she cherished time spent with them."
cases.narrative: On 4/16/2023, she died in the hospital. She had been shot in the head.
